Interface ReloadableBeanIntrospector

All Superinterfaces:
BeanIntrospector
@Internal public interface ReloadableBeanIntrospector extends BeanIntrospector
A BeanIntrospector that indexes the introspections of each class loader, and can forget the index of a loader whose classes changed. Only a development launcher, which replaces the application's classes, needs it.

5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • invalidate

      void invalidate(ClassLoader changed)
      Forgets the indexed introspections of the given class loader, and of every loader that delegates to it, so that the next lookup through them scans the classpath again.

      The scan reads the META-INF/micronaut service entries, which MicronautMetaServiceLoaderUtils caches for the whole process: a caller whose loader changed what it lists clears that cache first, with MicronautMetaServiceLoaderUtils.invalidate(), which this method leaves alone.

      The index of a loader other than the introspector's own is held softly, and it strongly refers to that loader: a launcher has to invalidate every loader it retires, or the index keeps the loader until the memory runs short.

      Parameters:
      changed - The class loader whose visible classes changed, such as a development launcher's delegating loader after it swapped the generation it delegates to, or a retired generation

    • invalidateShared
